$comment: PROPOSAL, NOT A DROP-IN CONFIGURATION. Regenerated 2026-09-06 after the
point-in-time fix, from gated backtest run 3 (3,147 trades) and ungated
capture run 3 (95,798 signals) over Nifty 500 daily candles, 2024-09-04 to
This file previously carried findings produced by a leaking feature engine.
Those findings are recorded under 'withdrawn_findings' rather than deleted,
so the record of what was believed and why it was wrong is preserved.
Result on corrected data: no strategy, filter or parameter in this dataset
has a demonstrated edge. Every 'enabled' flag is false and there is no
recommended configuration to adopt. The next step is hypothesis generation
with pre-committed acceptance criteria, not deployment.

leaky_comparison.$comment: Same window, gate and universe on the pre-fix engine. The leak did not inflate headline P&L; it fabricated structure.

resolved_defects.detail: Weekly and monthly features were built by grouping whole finished periods, so a signal fired mid-period was evaluated against that period's eventual high, low and close. Both the weekly and the monthly path leaked; an earlier audit wrongly reported the weekly path as clean.
resolved_defects.fix: _asof_period_blocks() exposes the last completed period's indicator state plus the in-progress period's OHLC as of the signal bar. _asof_ema() and _asof_rsi() apply one exact recursion step, so the in-progress value is exact rather than approximated.
resolved_defects.verification: backend/tests/regression/test_point_in_time.py computes every feature on the full history and on frames truncated at each date and requires equality at the truncation point. It also reconstructs the old grouping implementation and asserts the test rejects it.

resolved_defects.detail: A bare except turned 'every symbol crashed' into 'no signals found'. Two studies reported success while capturing nothing for their entire existence.
resolved_defects.fix: run_raw_signal_backtest() and run_sl_calibration_study() attach a diagnostics counter (symbols / no_data / short_history / no_features / failed / scanned) and raise when nothing was scanned.

resolved_defects.detail: Dhan returns IST-stamped epochs that were parsed as UTC.
177,890 rows written for 88,945 signals, from a redundant write in the job wrapper.
The feature snapshot cache served pre-fix features to a post-fix run, briefly making the corrected engine appear to still leak.
resolved_defects.fix: Cache is keyed on ENGINE_VERSION, bumped to FINAL-3_ASOF_PIT.

open_defects.detail: Today's Nifty 500 constituent list is applied to the whole history. Demoted names are absent; promoted names are present for periods when they were not members.
open_defects.fix: Store index membership with effective dates from today forward; the past cannot be recovered.

open_defects.detail: Assumes a fill at exactly the stop price. 109 of 1,599 stop-outs (6.8%) opened below the stop; realistic fill on those averaged -9.74% against -7.00% modelled, worst -19.41%.
Nothing adjusts for splits or bonuses. Unadjusted history would manufacture false breakdowns and false volume spikes.
open_defects.fix: Reconcile known 2024-2026 split dates against stored candles.

open_defects.detail: Many signals per stock with overlapping forward windows. The effective sample is far smaller than the row count, so any p-value computed on n is badly overstated.
open_defects.fix: Block bootstrap by symbol and date, or one-signal-per-symbol-per-window sampling, before any significance claim.

evidence.method: Average R by score band across 95,798 point-in-time ungated signals.
evidence.reading: No ordering. The populated range spans about 0.05R against roughly 0.21R on the leaky engine. The score neither selects nor anti-selects; it carries no information about outcome.

strategies.note: Largest contributor to signal count. Loses on both the gated and ungated samples; the two years disagree in sign, so the year-two positive is not evidence of an edge.
Positive gated on 44 trades, negative on 3,298 ungated signals. The gated positive is a small-sample artefact of the 85 gate, which the score evidence says is uninformative.
Now the worst performer, and negative in both years. Previously described as the one uncontaminated strategy; that was wrong, its weekly features leaked too.

gated_2y.note: no S4 signal cleared the 85 gate in two years

strategies.note: The only positive number of any size left in the system, and it is carried entirely by year two. Its leaky record was +1.286R at a 62.4% win rate, which is what first exposed the look-ahead.

filters.distance_sweep: 0.25 to 3.0+ ATR shows no plateau, and the two year-columns disagree in sign across most of the range.
filters.note: The sign inverts in both years independently, and in year two the extended cohort is the marginally positive one. This was the audit's only surviving edge; it does not survive.

feature_screen.$comment: Average R in the bottom vs top quintile of each field over 95,798 point-in-time ungated signals, with the spread's sign checked separately in each year. A field qualifies only if the direction agrees across years AND one extreme quintile is positive-expectancy in both years. These are screens, not significance tests; see open_defects.overlapping_samples.
feature_screen.interpretation: No feature captured at signal time identifies a cohort with positive expectancy in both years. The audit's conclusion that extension predicts underperformance does not survive either: dist_ema200_atr is no longer even direction-consistent (spread -0.073, years disagree), and dist_ema50_atr now reads the opposite way (+0.143).

evidence.sample: 3,147 gated trades, corrected engine, two years

stop_placement_study.detail: The five-scheme calibration ran on the leaky engine's signal set. Its conclusion — all five schemes lose, and the best beats the current fixed 7% stop by 0.011R — is not evidence until re-run point-in-time.
stop_placement_study.withdrawn_earlier_claim: A six-symbol preview put a 1.5x ATR stop well ahead of the fixed stop. At full scale it was the worst ATR scheme of three. The preview was noise.

exit_rules.note: Two thirds of trades reach +3% and 44% reach +7%, but the rule only pays at +21%, which 15% reach. The target half of the exit has never been varied in any study. It is the largest untested lever in the system and it says nothing about whether an edge exists.

withdrawn_findings.claim: The scoring system is inversely predictive; average R falls monotonically as score rises.
withdrawn_findings.basis_at_the_time: 88,945 ungated signals on the leaky engine, ordering reproduced in both years.
withdrawn_findings.why_withdrawn: The gradient was an artefact of the look-ahead. Low-score signals were disproportionately those whose higher-timeframe context came from an unfinished period. Corrected, all bands sit between -0.09R and -0.14R with no ordering.

withdrawn_findings.claim: Proximity to the 200 EMA is the one relationship that reproduces out of sample (+0.120R / +0.102R).
withdrawn_findings.basis_at_the_time: Bottom quintile of dist_ema200_atr, ~9,000 signals per year, win rates within 0.1 points.
withdrawn_findings.why_withdrawn: Recomputed point-in-time it is -0.065R and -0.083R. The sign inverted in both years independently and the distance sweep shows no plateau.

withdrawn_findings.claim: S3 is the only strategy whose backtest is trustworthy, because it reads no monthly fields.
withdrawn_findings.basis_at_the_time: Field-level inventory of strategy inputs; the weekly path was read as correctly as-of.
withdrawn_findings.why_withdrawn: The weekly path used the same whole-completed-period grouping. Every strategy was contaminated, so S3 was never a valid control. Two arguments that leaned on it as a control - that the trustworthy strategy loses money, and that the bear-regime edge vanishes on clean data - happen to hold on corrected data, but as new results rather than confirmed ones.

withdrawn_findings.claim: The 90-94 score band is the edge (+28.9R on 73 trades).
withdrawn_findings.why_withdrawn: Inverted out of sample: -37.4R in year one against +24.0R in year two on the same rule.

not_assessed.$comment: Requested by the brief; the data cannot support them. Listed so nothing here is mistaken for a gap in the analysis rather than a gap in the data.
not_assessed.timeframe_comparison: only daily candles stored; weekly and monthly are derived
not_assessed.parameter_sweeps: thresholds hard-coded in strategy_signal(); must be parameterised first
not_assessed.sharpe_sortino_cagr: backtest records R, not portfolio equity
not_assessed.monte_carlo: resampling overlapping trades without a block scheme produces confident nonsense
not_assessed.walk_forward_optimisation: there is no candidate with a positive in-sample edge to walk forward
not_assessed.survivorship_quantification: point-in-time index membership was never stored; not recoverable for this window

next_steps: Re-run the stop-placement calibration on the point-in-time engine so the exit study becomes evidence.
Vary the target, which no study has ever varied, against the observed +9% average favourable excursion.
Begin storing point-in-time Nifty 500 membership with effective dates.
Reconcile known 2024-2026 split and bonus dates against stored candles.
Before testing any new hypothesis, write down the acceptance criteria first: a stated mechanism, a pre-committed hold-out period, and a minimum effect size that clears realistic costs.
